source.content: Auth.JWT jwt = new Auth.JWT(); Auth.JWS jws = new Auth.JWS(jwt, 'certificate'); Auth.JWS clonedJws = (Auth.JWS)jws.clone(); Auth.JWTBearerTokenExchange exchange = new Auth.JWTBearerTokenExchange(); Auth.JWTBearerTokenExchange clonedExchange = (Auth.JWTBearerTokenExchange)exchange.clone(); Auth.VerificationResult verification = new Auth.VerificationResult(new PageReference('/verified'), true, 'ok'); Auth.VerificationResult clonedVerification = (Auth.VerificationResult)verification.clone(); System.assert(clonedJws != jws); System.assert(clonedExchange != exchange); System.assert(clonedVerification != verification); System.assertEquals('/verified', clonedVerification.redirect.getUrl()); System.assertEquals(true, clonedVerification.success); System.assertEquals('ok', clonedVerification.message);
